description:
Use this when the user asks for official Indian macro data: CPI inflation, WPI, IIP, GDP or the crude-oil basket price.

Returns official Indian macro series, newest period first. `dataset` is required: "cpi" (consumer prices, headline and by group), "wpi" (wholesale prices, overall and food only), "iip" (industrial production by category), "gdp" (annual level and growth, one row per published estimate) or "crude_basket" (the Indian crude basket monthly average, USD per barrel). `from_period` and `to_period` are YYYY-MM, or a fiscal year such as 2024-25 for gdp. `series_contains` keeps series whose name contains the text, such as Food or Manufacturing. `limit` is 1 to 2000 (default 200). For rupee exchange rates use get_fx_reference_rates.

dataset.description: Required. One of: cpi, wpi, iip, gdp, crude_basket.
